outdated_hmux0_csv.title: Outdated 08.hmux0.csv file in eBUSd
outdated_hmux0_csv.description: Your `ebusd` instance is using an older version of `vaillant/08.hmux0.csv` (reporting a static 900 l/h flow rate or legacy `StateCompressor` fields). Please copy the updated `ebusd-configuration/vaillant/08.hmux0.csv` (v1.2.4+) into your `ebusd` configuration folder and restart `ebusd` to enable the real-time vortex water flow sensor (`540200090b`), the `D2C` fix in `StateCompressor`, and optimized polling priorities. This repair notice will clear automatically once `ebusd` reloads the updated CSV.

outdated_controller_csv.title: Outdated controller CSV file in eBUSd
outdated_controller_csv.description: Your `ebusd` instance is using an older version of `vaillant/15.bass3.csv`, `15.basv3.csv`, `15.ctlv2.csv`, or `15.ctlv3.csv` (reporting legacy `Z1HolidayTemp` instead of Zone 1 mapped Holiday Mode registers). Please copy the updated `ebusd-configuration/vaillant/*.csv` into your `ebusd` configuration folder and restart `ebusd` to enable real-time Holiday Mode synchronization and active cooling season parameters. This repair notice will clear automatically once `ebusd` reloads the updated CSV.

missing_custom_csv.title: Custom eBUSd CSV files not loaded or incomplete scan
missing_custom_csv.description: Your `ebusd` instance has active eBUS signal, but one or more required CSV circuits (`08.hmux0.csv`/`08.hmu.HW5103.csv`, `15.bass3.csv`/`15.basv3.csv`/`15.ctlv2.csv`/`15.ctlv3.csv`, or `76.vwzio.csv`) did not load or timed out during initial scan (`scan config ERR: read timeout`). Please verify that `broadcast.csv` and `vaillant/*.csv` from `ebusd-configuration/` are copied into your `ebusd` `--configpath` directory and restart `ebusd`. This repair notice will clear automatically once all three circuits report telemetry.

no_ebusd_mqtt_traffic.title: No MQTT traffic received on prefix {mqtt_prefix}
no_ebusd_mqtt_traffic.description: Home Assistant has not received any messages from `ebusd` under the configured MQTT topic prefix `{mqtt_prefix}/#`. Please verify that: (1) the MQTT topic prefix matches your `ebusd` configuration (`--mqtttopic=ebusd/%circuit/%name`), and (2) the `ebusd` add-on or service is running and connected to your MQTT broker. This repair notice will clear automatically as soon as the first message arrives.

mqttjson_not_enabled.title: The --mqttjson flag is not enabled in eBUSd
mqttjson_not_enabled.description: Your `ebusd` instance is publishing plain-text semicolon-separated values instead of JSON objects. Please add `--mqttjson` to your `ebusd` startup arguments and restart `ebusd` so multi-field telemetry (compressor state, weekly timers, dates, and live power) can be decoded properly. This repair notice will clear automatically once JSON messages arrive.

set_weekly_timer.name: Set Weekly Schedule Timer (b5 55)
set_weekly_timer.description: Configures a weekly schedule time slot on the climate controller (15.bass3 / 15.ctlv2 / 15.ctlv3) for Zone 1 Heating, Domestic Hot Water (DHW), Cooling, or Circulation. Supports configuring slots (1, 2, 3), deleting individual slots, or clearing the entire day.

circuit_type.name: Circuit Type
circuit_type.description: Schedule circuit to modify (Heating, DHW, Cooling, or Circulation).

day.name: Day of the Week
day.description: Specific day of the week, Weekdays, Weekend, or All Days. Accepts English and Spanish names.

action.name: Action
action.description: Action to perform: 'set' to add/update a time slot, 'delete' to remove a specific slot, or 'clear' to erase all slots for the day.

slot.name: Time Slot Number
slot.description: Daily time slot index (1, 2, or 3). Defaults to 1.

start_time.name: Start Time
start_time.description: Slot start time in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g. 13:10). Required for action 'set'.

end_time.name: End Time
end_time.description: Slot end time in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g. 14:50, or 24:00 for all day). Required for action 'set'.

temp.name: Target Temperature Setpoint (Optional)
temp.description: Target temperature setpoint in °C for this slot. If omitted, uses current circuit setpoint.

reset_remaining.name: Reset Remaining Slots (Overwrite Day)
reset_remaining.description: When enabled with slot 1, overwrites the day with only this slot (total_slots=1), resetting slots 2 and 3 if they existed.

force_dhw_boost.name: Activate Smart Forced DHW Boost
force_dhw_boost.description: Initiates a one-time domestic hot water tank charge (HwcSFMode = load) automatically overcoming thermostat hysteresis via dynamic temporary setpoint elevation (T_current + hysteresis + 1.5 °C) and restores original setpoint upon completion.

boost_temp.name: Temporary Boost Temperature (Optional - Solar Surpluses)
boost_temp.description: Optional temporary setpoint in °C for this specific boost cycle (e.g. 60 °C for PV solar surpluses). If omitted, automatically applies T_current + hysteresis + 1.5 °C.

set_holiday_mode.name: Set Holiday / Away Mode
set_holiday_mode.description: Activates Holiday/Away Mode on the climate controller (15.bass3 / 15.ctlv2 / 15.ctlv3), suspending hot water production and reducing heating setpoint to setback temperature during a timed or open-ended window.

start_date.name: Start Date (Optional)
start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY format. Defaults to today.

start_time.name: Start Time (Optional)
start_time.description: Start time in HH:MM format. Defaults to current time.

end_date.name: End Date (Optional)
end_date.description: End date of absence. If omitted, sets an open-ended/indefinite absence until manually cancelled.

end_time.name: End Time (Optional)
end_time.description: End time in HH:MM format (defaults to 23:59).

cancel_holiday_mode.name: Cancel Holiday / Away Mode
cancel_holiday_mode.description: Immediately cancels Holiday/Away Mode on the climate controller (15.bass3 / 15.ctlv2 / 15.ctlv3) and restores automatic schedule operation for heating and domestic hot water.

dump_mqtt_values.name: Dump MQTT Values (Diagnostics)
dump_mqtt_values.description: Dumps full installation state and eBUSd MQTT telemetry into a structured JSON format suitable for troubleshooting or attaching to GitHub issues.

circuit.name: Circuit Filter (Optional)
circuit.description: Filters telemetry by a specific eBUS circuit (e.g. '08', '15', 'hmu', 'bass3'). If omitted, dumps all active circuits.

anonymize.name: Anonymize Serial Numbers (Recommended)
anonymize.description: Automatically masks 28-character hardware serial numbers so diagnostic dumps can be safely shared in public GitHub issue threads.

record_topic_changes.name: Record MQTT Topic Changes (Live Diagnostics)
record_topic_changes.description: Records real-time eBUSd MQTT traffic for a configurable duration, capturing topics, raw payloads, and timestamps.

duration.name: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Recording duration in seconds (between 5 and 120 seconds, defaults to 30).

circuit.name: Circuit / Topic Substring Filter (Optional)
circuit.description: Filters captured messages by substring (e.g. '08', '15', 'hmu'). If omitted, records all MQTT traffic under prefix.

anonymize.name: Anonymize Serial Numbers (Recommended)
anonymize.description: Automatically masks manufacturing serial numbers and hardware identifiers found in payloads.

send_hex_command.name: Send Direct Raw HEX Command (TCP Diagnostics)
send_hex_command.description: Sends a raw hexadecimal command telegram to the eBUSd daemon over TCP (port 8888) and returns decoded response bytes. Requires eBUSd running with '--enablehex' and the 'enable_send_hex' option enabled in integration options. Does not require modifying CSV files.

command.name: Hexadecimal Command String
command.description: Hex byte string to send (spaces are automatically stripped, e.g. '08b51a0405ff3428').

host.name: Host / IP Address (Optional)
host.description: IP address or hostname where eBUSd daemon is running (defaults to 127.0.0.1 or b4d7ad18-ebusd).

timeout.name: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to connect and await daemon response (defaults to 5.0 seconds).

read_parameter.name: Read Parameter via MQTT
read_parameter.description: Reads a symbolic eBUSd register via MQTT (publishing to '<prefix>/<circuit>/<name>/get' and awaiting reply on '<prefix>/<circuit>/<name>'). Supports returning cached value or forcing an active bus read.

name.name: Parameter / Message Name
name.description: Symbolic register name as defined in CSV files (e.g. 'CompressorSilentOperationLevel', 'Status01', 'Z1OpMode').

force.name: Force Physical Bus Read (Optional)
force.description: If true, forces an active read from the physical bus instead of returning cached value if present.

timeout.name: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for eBUSd reply via MQTT (defaults to 5.0 seconds).

write_parameter.name: Write Parameter via MQTT
write_parameter.description: Writes a value to a symbolic eBUSd register via MQTT (publishing to '<prefix>/<circuit>/<name>/set'). Applies optimistic state update in Home Assistant and leverages intelligent circuit alias routing.

name.name: Parameter / Message Name
name.description: Symbolic register name as defined in CSV files (e.g. 'CompressorSilentOperationLevel', 'Z1OpMode').

value.name: Value to Write
value.description: Value or string payload to send to eBUSd.
